name: Shooter
description: Weapons, movement and AI in levels built for firefights, with an optional networking pillar for multiplayer.

pillars.name: Firing
pillars.description: Hitscan or projectiles, fire rates and hit detection.

pillars.name: Recoil and Spread
pillars.description: Recoil patterns, spread and how they reward control.

pillars.name: Attachments
pillars.description: Scopes, grips and other modifiers, and how they change a weapon.

pillars.name: Player Movement
pillars.description: Running, crouching, sliding, mantling and how movement interacts with aiming.

pillars.name: Perception
pillars.description: What AI can see and hear, and how it notices the player.

pillars.name: Squad Behavior
pillars.description: How AI coordinates: flanking, suppression and callouts.

pillars.name: Levels
pillars.description: Maps built for firefights: sightlines, cover placement and flow.

pillars.name: Game Modes
pillars.description: The rules of each mode: objectives, scoring and rounds.

pillars.name: Networking
pillars.description: Multiplayer: replication, lag compensation and matchmaking. Remove if single-player.

pillars.name: Replication
pillars.description: What's synced, how often, and who has authority.

pillars.name: Audio
pillars.description: Gunfire, footsteps and positional audio that the player relies on to read the fight.

pillars.name: UI and HUD
pillars.description: Crosshair, ammo, health, hit markers, the scoreboard and menus.
